title: Define Drizzle ORM Schema and Migration for API Keys
description: Add a new `apiKeys` table to the Drizzle ORM schema and generate the corresponding migration.
details: Update `lib/db/schema.ts` (or equivalent) to define the `apiKeys` table with columns: `id` (UUID, PK), `userId` (FK to users), `hashedKey` (string), `name` (string), `createdAt` (timestamp), and `lastUsedAt` (timestamp, nullable). Use Drizzle's migration tooling to generate and apply the migration. Ensure the table enforces user association and unique constraints as needed.
test_strategy:
- Verify migration applies cleanly in development and staging environments.
- Confirm the table structure in the database matches the schema definition.
- Attempt to insert and query sample data via Drizzle to ensure correct integration.

title: Implement Server Actions for API Key Management
description: Create server actions for creating, listing, and revoking API keys, ensuring secure key handling and user scoping.
details:
In `app/dashboard/settings/api-keys/actions.ts`, implement:
- `createApiKey`: Generates a secure random key (with prefix), hashes it (bcrypt or Argon2), stores the hash, and returns the plain key for one-time display. Associates the key with the authenticated user.
- `getApiKeysForUser`: Returns all API keys for the current user (excluding the plain key).
- `revokeApiKey`: Deletes or marks an API key as revoked for the user.
All actions must validate user authentication via Better Auth and ensure only the user's keys are accessible. Log key creation and revocation events for audit purposes.
test_strategy:
- Unit test key generation and hashing logic.
- Integration test each server action for correct DB interaction and user scoping.
- Attempt unauthorized access to ensure proper access control.

title: Build API Key Management UI in Dashboard
description: Develop the frontend page and components for API key management within the dashboard, using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
details:
Create `app/dashboard/settings/api-keys/page.tsx`:
- Display a table of the user's API keys (name, created date, last used, partial key, revoke button).
- Add a '+ Create New Key' button that opens a Dialog for entering a key name.
- On successful creation, show the plain-text key in the Dialog for one-time copy, with a warning it won't be shown again.
- Use shadcn/ui components (Card, Button, Dialog, Table) for consistency.
- Handle loading, error, and empty states gracefully.
test_strategy:
- Manual UI testing for all flows (create, view, revoke).
- Accessibility audit (keyboard navigation, ARIA roles).
- Visual regression check for dark/light mode compatibility.

title: Integrate API Keys Page into Dashboard Navigation
description: Add a navigation link to the new API Keys page in the dashboard sidebar or settings menu.
details: Update `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` or the shared sidebar component to include a link to `/dashboard/settings/api-keys`. Ensure the link is visible only to authenticated users and follows the existing navigation style.
test_strategy:
- Confirm the link appears in the sidebar/settings menu.
- Verify navigation works and the page is protected by authentication middleware.
- Check for correct active state styling.
